# JBStaycation

> A quieter escape, just across the causeway. Private holiday houses in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, for Singapore families and groups. Booking by WhatsApp only: +65 9006 2198 (https://wa.me/6590062198). Prices in RM.

## Houses
- [Prima, Taman Nusantara Prima](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/jb-staycation/stays/prima-taman-nusantara-prima/): 19 Jalan Prima 3/1, Taman Nusantara Prima, Iskandar Puteri, Johor 79200, Malaysia. Up to 20 guests, RM 500 per night. A private house in Gelang Patah, Iskandar Puteri for up to 20 guests with a pool table in the living room, karaoke, a mahjong table and a BBQ pit, about 10 minutes from the Tuas Second Link (host estimate).
- [Landak Kawan Fun House, Taman Abad](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/jb-staycation/stays/landak-kawan-fun-house-taman-abad/): Jalan Landak Kawan 2, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru, Johor 80250, Malaysia. Up to 10 guests, RM 500 per night. A new double-storey house for up to 10 guests with a pool table, foosball, darts and a TV with arcade games, a 5-minute walk from KSL City Mall.
